tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) 2105 and 2211. Strong proficiency in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, OCC web services, and database performance tuning. Proven expertise integrating PIM, ERP, and MDM systems within agile enterprise environments. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer holding a valid German residence and work permit.

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer role at agap2 Italia. With over 5 years of professional backend engineering experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in building and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, adhering to platform best practices.

bullets.label: OCC APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and custom Interceptors, Populators, and Converters to support seamless data flows with external systems.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub while investigating integration bottlenecks with SAP ERP and MDM platforms.

bullets.label: Cloud & Performance
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud CCv2 and led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed.

cover_en.gap: While I bring extensive SAP Commerce Cloud and Java expertise, I am keen to further expand my hands-on exposure to SAP Commerce Composable Storefront (Spartacus) and Angular as required by your tech stack.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period through 15 December 2026, with my earliest start date available on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your team's goals.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at agap2 Italia because of your dynamic environment, commitment to continuous evolution, and dedication to putting human relationships at the center of engineering consultancy. Contributing to impactful enterprise e-commerce solutions for diverse international clients within your collaborative multidisciplinary teams aligns perfectly with my professional background.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java expertise to deliver scalable e-commerce solutions within agile, multidisciplinary teams.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience in Java, Spring, and enterprise Hybris implementations. My profile matches your team's tech stack. I hold a valid work permit in Germany and am available starting December 16, 2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce Cloud Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer position at agap2 Italia. With over 5 years of backend engineering experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring across enterprise projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to contribute to your digital solutions.

I hold a valid residence and work permit for Germany and am available starting December 16, 2026, following my notice period. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
